```{r import data, include=FALSE}
# Import Pitnacree flow data directly from ZIP file in Github
pitnacree <- read.csv(unz("pitnacree.zip", "pitnacree.csv"))

pitnacree <- pitnacree %>%
  mutate(Timestamp = ymd_hms(Timestamp, tz = "UTC"))
```


### Importing Peaks ###
```{r peaks}
# Put Pitnacree on a continuous 15-minute grid
pit <- tibble(
  Timestamp = seq(
    min(pitnacree$Timestamp),
    max(pitnacree$Timestamp),
    by = "15 min"
  )
) %>%
  left_join(
    pitnacree %>% dplyr::select(Timestamp, Value),
    by = "Timestamp"
  )

flow <- pit$Value
flow_noNA <- replace_na(flow, 0) # 0 ensures peak detection ignores missing intervals


# Extract candidate peaks exceeding the specified threshold
raw <- findpeaks(flow_noNA, minpeakheight = threshold, minpeakdistance = 1, zero = "0")

cand <- tibble(
  max_flow   = raw[, 1],
  max_time   = raw[, 2],
  peak_begin = raw[, 3],
  peak_end   = raw[, 4]
) %>%
  arrange(max_time) %>%
  mutate(ttr = max_time - peak_begin) # Time to rise in 15-min steps


# Compute average time to peak from "clean" isolated events
near_other <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(cand)), function(i) {
  any(abs(cand$max_time[-i] - cand$max_time[i]) < 7 * steps_per_day)
})

clean <- cand %>%
  mutate(clean = flow[peak_begin] < 0.5 * max_flow & !near_other & !is.na(flow[peak_begin]))

avg_ttr <- mean(clean$ttr[clean$clean])
min_sep <- 3 * avg_ttr
cat(sprintf("Avg time to peak: %.2f hours | Min FEH separation: %.2f hours\n", avg_ttr / 4, min_sep / 4))


# Filter candidate peaks using FEH independence criteria 
keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(cand))
last <- 1

for (k in 2:nrow(cand)) {
  sep <- cand$max_time[k] - cand$max_time[last]
  independent <- sep >= min_sep
  
  if (independent) {
    trough <- min(flow[cand$max_time[last]:cand$max_time[k]], na.rm = TRUE)
    independent <- trough < (2/3) * cand$max_flow[last]
  }
  
  if (independent) {
    last <- k
  } else if (cand$max_flow[k] > cand$max_flow[last]) {
    keep[last] <- FALSE
    last <- k
  } else {
    keep[k] <- FALSE
  }
}

peaks_passed <- cand[keep, ]
n_years <- sum(!is.na(flow)) / (steps_per_day * 365.25)


```
